contexts.text: There are penalties under veils, etc.

One of the frequent punishments is the casting over of the veil... By phantasies impressed upon them they seem to themselves to be under a veil which is extended to a great distance. It is like a closely clinging cloud, which is made dense according to the phantasy. They run about beneath it, at various speeds, and the desire to break forth from it is kindled until they are quite wearied out. This usually lasts an hour, more or less, and is accompanied with torment proportionate to the degree of the desire to extricate themselves. The veil is for those who, although they see truth, are yet unwilling to acknowledge it, from the love of self... Some, when under the veil, feel such anxiety and terror that they despair of ever being delivered. SE 435, Further explained.

There is another kind of veil, which consists in their being rolled up as it were in a cloth, so that they seem to themselves to be bound, hand, foot, and body, and a burning desire to unroll themselves is injected into them. As he has been rolled up in one fold, the Spirit supposes that he will easily become unrolled; but when he begins to unroll himself, the veil stretches out in length, and the unrolling goes on continuously until he despairs. SE 1371-1376, Further described.
Such (introductory) things were represented by the door and the veils of the Tent, and also of the Temple.

As rational truths... are a kind of veil or clothing to spiritual truths... we may... explain what was signified by the veils (of the Tent)... There were three veils; the first made the division between the Holy and the Holy of Holies; the second is called the hanging for the door of the Tent; and the third was the hanging for the gate of the court. The veil itself (is described in ). This veil represented the nearest and inmost appearances of rational good and truth, in which are the Angels of the Third Heaven, which appearances are described by the hyacinthine, bright crimson, double-dyed scarlet, and fine twined linen; in which the red colour represented the good of love, and the white its truths.

From this it is evident what is signified by the veil of the temple being rent in twain (; ; ); namely, that the Lord had entered into the Divine Itself, all appearances being dispersed; and that at the same time He had opened an approach to the Divine Itself through His Human made Divine.

The second veil (is described in ). By this hanging were represented appearances of good and truth which are lower or more external than the former, that is, the middle appearances of the Rational, in which are the Angels of the Second Heaven...

The third veil (is described in ). By this hanging were represented still lower or more external appearances of good and truth, which are the lowest appearances of the Rational, in which are the Angels of the First Heaven...

Thus when the externals of the Ancient Church, and also of the Jewish Church, are unfolded and as it were unwrapped, the Christian Church is disclosed. This also was signified by the veil of the temple being rent in twain.
To cover the face () = that truth should not be seen at all. (Compare AC 6848.)
The great danger the Angels would be in if they were looked at by the Divine without the veiling over of a cloud. Explained.
A veiling over of the interiors so that they may appear in the holiness of faith... Signified, Explained.

Unless the internals (of the Israelites) had been veiled over, they would have appeared in plain view, and then the Representative would have perished. Explained... Thus to sanctify = a veiling over of the interiors... AC 8806. AC 8838.
Hence even the Angels are veiled over with a cloud. HH 120, Described.
And therefore all who are in Hell are veiled over with dense clouds; for such clouds = falsities.

The Divine truth cannot possibly appear in its own bright beams; for... the light would blind the understanding... and therefore it is... as it were veiled over with a cloud... With Spirits this veiling over appears as a cloud, which is dense or thin according to the reception of each person.
In ()... there is represented the medium which unites the Second Heaven and the Inmost Heaven by the veil between the Habitation and the ark of the testimony. AC 9596, Explained.
Thou shalt make a veil () = the medium uniting (these two Heavens), thus spiritual good with celestial good. Explained.
The intermediate angelic Societies which... were represented by the veil. Described... They correspond to the cardiac and pulmonary plexuses... and also to the medulla oblongata...

The veil of the temple being rent in twain... signified the glorification of the Lord; for, while in the world, He made His Human Divine truth, but when He went out of the world He made His Human Divine good... and the Divine good is the Holy of Holies.

The glorification of the Lord's Human even to Divine good... is also described by the process of expiation when Aaron entered into the Holy of Holies within the veil (); and by the same process there is described, in the representative sense, the regeneration of man even to celestial good. Explained.
(Thus) the veil between the Holy and the Holy of Holies also = the medium which unites the Divine truth and the Divine good in the Lord.

(For) those in Heaven who relate to the uniting medium which is represented by the veil, have the goods of love and the goods of faith conjoined together in them; for, through the goods of love they are conjoined with the celestials in the Inmost Heaven, and through the goods of faith with the spirituals who are in the Middle Heaven... (These Angels) are called celestial spiritual and spiritual celestial Angels; the former being represented by Joseph, and the latter by Benjamin.
Thou shalt set the table outside the veil () = influx through the celestial things of love; (for) outside the veil = outside the uniting medium through which is mediate influx...

From without the veil which is over the Testimony () = where there is communication, and, through the uniting medium, conjunction with the Lord in the Inmost Heaven; for the veil = the medium which unites the Inmost and the Middle Heavens; thus where there are communication and conjunction. AC 10005:3.
The neck corresponds to the medium which imites the Inmost and the Middle Heavens; in like manner as does the veil in the Tent.
Thou shalt put (the altar of incense) before the veil... () = in the interior Heaven where it is conjoined with the Inmost Heaven. Explained.
The evil of the spirit of man then lay veiled around... with external probity...
That the sense of the letter of the Word is signified by the curtains and veils of the Tabernacle. (Explained.)
These curtains and veils represented the externals of Heaven and the Church, thus also the externals of the Word. DSS 46:end 97[3].
The concupiscences of evil are (then) like a dense veil... beneath the spiritual mind...
(Thus) the proceeding Divine is in every man, but is variously veiled over by each person.
For prior things... are less veiled over with substances and matters devoid of life.
He is like... a sail by which a ship can be turned... DP 198:end. TCR 381:3.
Such close the interiors of their minds, and interpose as it were a veil, and they afterwards think below the veil.
For with these there is no veil between the interiors and the exteriors, that is, between the spiritual and the natural things of the mind, as there is with the sensuous.
The Lord so... tempers His Divine, that man can endure His presence. This is done by veilings over... By veilings over He is present with everyone who worships Him.
A vessel with seven sails seen flying in the air.
When the Lord presents Himself to view... He veils Himself over... by means of an Angel.
Then the internal Conjugial is veiled over...
(Such) is his management of his sails.
That the veil (seen) before the cherub had been lifted, signified that the Word has now been laid open... (It also means the same as Nunc licet. Fully Explained TCR 508:5.)
He begins... to veil around (his evils) with reasonings... TCR 568:4.
The confirmation of what is false... places as it were a veil beneath the understanding...
For the sight of the spirit is veiled over by the natural sight.
On the veil of the Jews; and a kind of punishment by the veil.

In the other life, when the Jews wish to protect anyone... they are wont to throw a veil over him... and then no violence can be inflicted on him. Some Christians... when under this veil, complained that they could not breathe... Jews are safer when quite obscured, and are in a dense cloud, than those who are in the light of Truth, and yet deny; and therefore, even in life, they are kept continually under a veil.

As to the vastation by the veil, a man cannot be put under it... But instead of this torment he has this: that when he wishes to recall to memory Truths... his ideas are taken away... and meanwhile his desire of knowing or writing is inflamed, and he feels indignation, and a desire to persevere... These things correspond to the veil with Spirits.
The penalty of vastation of the woollen veil. General article. SE 1410, continued.
Viciousness together with their phantasies are thus represented by the veil... SE 1414, Example(s).
(The sphere of one who regarded others as of no account appeared) bent round like a white veil in the atmosphere. Described.
(The fall of Angels from Heaven represented by a veil. Described.)
An upright person wrapped up in a veil... who could not be unwrapped from that veil until he had made supplication.
Concerning a subtle veil. Explained.
Concerning (David) in the veil. Described. SE 3840:2.
He was enveloped as it were in a misty veil of authority, and was let down.
Concerning a person who had the habit of naming the devil, and was therefore let into the veil.
The veil of the temple being rent in twain = the union of the Lord's Divine Human with the Divine Itself. AE 400:14.
Thou hast covered it with the deep as with a garment () = the sensuous Scientific which is the ultimate of the natural man... AE 405:21, (Explained.)
(The things within and without the veil of the Tabernacle. Explained.) AE 324:4.

The veil (that was rent in twain) = the external of the Church as it was with the Jews... and which covered their eyes so that they should not see the Lord and the Divine truth or the Word in its light.

The reason Moses veiled his face when he spoke to the people () was that the internal of the Word was covered, and thus obscured to that people, so that they might not endure anything of the light from it.

(These) holy things could not be called holy and a sanctuary until they had been covered with curtains and veils; for without these coverings they would have stood under the naked sky, exposed to showers and storms, to the birds of heaven and the wild beasts of the earth, and also to robbers... So would it he with the Divine truths in the Heavens... unless they were enclosed in natural truths, like those of the sense of the letter...
